title: EdgeMetrics — realtime observability at the edge
summary: Multi-region ingest and rollup pipeline that keeps p95 query latency under 60 ms at 128k requests per second.
problem: The client's dashboard read from a single Postgres cluster in eu-central. Customers in APAC waited 2–4 seconds for a chart to render, and every product launch pushed the cluster closer to its connection limit. A rewrite was on the table; a targeted redesign was enough.
solution: I moved aggregation to the edge: workers write compact rollups into Durable Object storage per region, and a read-only query service fans out to the three nearest regions, merging partials in memory. Raw events still land in object storage for backfill, but dashboards never touch it.
role: Lead engineer — architecture, edge services, frontend
